notes: Grenades: frag on G (hold to cook, release to throw along the previewed arc, 7 m blast with cover checks, host-applied damage and kill credit) and flashbang on H (whiteout and ringing when you were looking at it), one of each per life. New attachments on every gun: Grip (less spread and kick), Fast mag (quicker reloads), Flashlight. Seasons: four-week ranked seasons; rank points archive and reset at the start of each, the emblem shows the season, last season's podium appears on the Leaderboard tab. Party codes: the lobby shows a code, friends type it into the ranked menu to join without an invite.
